items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: So I got him a few times to play with me.

ctx.x: He played Madeline and off the trombone, played several instruments. He went out to see Dewey, I believe the last time he was here with my partner, Bill Russell.

Yeah. And then we had that young man, he was a little young boy. I used to have him get a trumpet player from the city. And every time he'd play a few jobs and he'd get a better job, he'd send somebody else. So he brought that fellow Alcorn. I don't remember Alcorn. I know you know him. I can't think of his name. Alcorn. He was a little short chunky fellow. He played a trumpet.
